author: Forbes
description: Leading through uncertainty isn’t optional, it’s the job. From the #Under30Summit main stage, Anjali Sud, CEO of Tubi, on taking Vimeo public at the peak of SaaS and then having to lead through the shift when the market turned. Learning to tune out the noise and stay focused is what actually gets you through it. #ForbesUnder30
